label: In a stipulated two-party electorate with three districts of three voters each, counting every…
paraphrase: In a stipulated two-party electorate with three districts of three voters each, counting every ballot once, the packed profile has five A ballots but loses two districts. A second profile with the same total five A and four B ballots, grouped 2,2,1 instead of 3,1,1, wins two districts. For every profile unanimous A implies both popular and district victory; unanimous B implies neither. The finite aggregation test establishes no claim about actual boundaries, proportional fairness, consent, or justified political authority.
